atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(20, "Coil Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
vovLookback = input(20, "VoV Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
predLookback = input(20, "Predictability Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
compressionLevel = input(0.25, "Compression Level", 0.05, 0.5, 0.05)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)
enable3D = input(1, "Enable 3D", 0, 1, 1)

tr1 = high - low
tr2 = abs(high - close[1])
tr3 = abs(low - close[1])
trMax = max(tr1, tr2)
tr = max(trMax, tr3)
a = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
aSafe = max(a, 0.0001)
aPrev = max(a[1], 0.0001)
rng = high - low
rngSafe = max(rng, 0.0000001)
rngPrev = max(rng[1], 0.0000001)
coilBasis = rng / aSafe

coilRank = 0.0
for i = 1 to 100 {
  if i <= coilLookback {
    if coilBasis[i] < coilBasis {
      coilRank = coilRank + 1.0
    }
  }
}
coilDen = max(coilLookback, 1.0)
coilLoadRaw = 1 - coilRank / coilDen
microJitter = (close - open) / aSafe
coilLoad = coilLoadRaw + 0.05 * microJitter
coilLoad = max(coilLoad, 0.0)
coilLoad = min(coilLoad, 1.0)

vovRaw = stdev(a, vovLookback) / aSafe
vov = vovRaw
vovRank = 0.0
for i = 1 to 100 {
  if i <= vovLookback {
    if vov[i] < vov {
      vovRank = vovRank + 1.0
    }
  }
}
vovDen = max(vovLookback, 1.0)
vovPct = vovRank / vovDen
vovHigh = vovPct > 0.7
vovRising = vov > vov[1] and vovHigh

ch = close - close[1]
absCh = abs(ch)
sumR = rng
sumCh = ch
for i = 1 to 100 {
  if i < predLookback {
    sumR = sumR + rng[i]
    sumCh = sumCh + ch[i]
  }
}
sumRSafe = max(sumR, 0.0000001)
disp = abs(sumCh)
pred = disp / sumRSafe
predRising = pred > pred[1]

baseThresh = 1 - compressionLevel
atrChg = (aSafe - aPrev) / aSafe
loadThreshDyn = baseThresh + 0.1 * atrChg
loadThreshDyn = max(loadThreshDyn, 0.5)
loadThreshDyn = min(loadThreshDyn, 0.95)

maxNeed1 = max(coilLookback, vovLookback)
maxNeed = max(maxNeed1, predLookback) + 5
warmupOk = bar_index > maxNeed
atrFilled = a > 0 and a[1] > 0
dataFilled = warmupOk and atrFilled

loaded = coilLoad > loadThreshDyn and dataFilled
loadedPrev = coilLoad[1] > loadThreshDyn
coiled = (loaded or loadedPrev) and dataFilled
rangeExp = rng / rngPrev
atrExp = aSafe / aPrev
releaseImp = max(rangeExp, atrExp)
releaseHot = releaseImp > releaseMult and dataFilled
breakUp = close > high[1]
breakDn = close < low[1]

predictable = predRising and pred > 0.25
predictableState = predictable and dataFilled

var cool = 0
cool := max(cool - 1, 0)
rawBuy = coiled and vovRising and releaseHot and breakUp and predictableState
rawSell = coiled and vovRising and releaseHot and breakDn and predictableState
buySig = rawBuy and cool == 0
sellSig = rawSell and cool == 0
if buySig or sellSig {
  cool := 5
}

coilTerrain = coilLoad * rngSafe + aSafe * 0.2
predTerrain = pred * rngSafe + aSafe * 0.1
predictableLoad = coilLoad * pred

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "separate") }

plot(coilLoad, "Coil Load", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(pred, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
plot(loadThreshDyn, "Load Threshold", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot3d(coilTerrain, "Coil Terrain 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predTerrain, "Predict Terrain 3D", "bars3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)

// Multi-Timeframe Siege Range Model
sessLen = input(20, "Session Length Bars", 10, 500, 1)
htfLook = input(3, "1h Confirmation Lookback", 1, 20, 1)
qualThresh = input(60, "Structure Quality Threshold", 0, 100, 1)
stopTicks = input(10, "Hard Stop Offset Ticks", 1, 100, 1)
confLen = input(14, "Confidence Period", 2, 100, 1)
tickSize = input(0.1, "Tick Size", 0.01, 5.0, 0.01)

sessHigh = highest(high, sessLen)
sessLow = lowest(low, sessLen)
sessMid = (sessHigh + sessLow) / 2
sessRng = sessHigh - sessLow

h1Close = security("1h", close)
h1Open = security("1h", open)
h1High = security("1h", high)
h1Low = security("1h", low)
h1HighPrev = h1High[1]
h1LowPrev = h1Low[1]
priorHigh = highest(h1HighPrev, htfLook)
priorLow = lowest(h1LowPrev, htfLook)

bullStruct = h1Close > priorHigh and h1Low > priorLow
bearStruct = h1Close < priorLow and h1High < priorHigh

h1Rng = h1High - h1Low
dispRaw = h1Rng > 0 ? abs(h1Close - h1Open) / h1Rng : 0
dispRatio = dispRaw > 1 ? 1 : dispRaw
rangeRaw = sessRng > 0 ? abs(close - sessMid) / (sessRng * 0.5) : 0
rangePos = rangeRaw > 1 ? 1 : rangeRaw
quality = 50 + 25 * dispRatio + 25 * rangePos
conf = sma(quality, confLen)
confOk = conf >= qualThresh

longStop = sessLow - stopTicks * tickSize
shortStop = sessHigh + stopTicks * tickSize

brokeHigh = close > sessHigh[1] and close[1] <= sessHigh[1]
brokeLow = close < sessLow[1] and close[1] >= sessLow[1]
buySig = brokeHigh and bullStruct and confOk
sellSig = brokeLow and bearStruct and confOk
longExitSig = crossunder(close, sessMid) or (not bullStruct and bullStruct[1])
shortExitSig = crossover(close, sessMid) or (not bearStruct and bearStruct[1])

if buySig {
    model.confidence(conf / 100)
    model.stopLoss(close - longStop, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(conf / 100)
    model.stopLoss(shortStop - close, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
}

plot(sessHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(sessLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")
plot(longStop, "Long Stop", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")
plot(shortStop, "Short Stop", "#ffaa00", 1, "stepline")

volatilityLength = input(14, "Volatility Length", 5, 30, 1)
momentumLength = input(12, "Momentum Length", 5, 30, 1)
breakoutLength = input(20, "Breakout Length", 10, 50, 1)
volatilityMult = input(1.5, "Volatility Mult", 0.5, 3.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

volatilityRange = high - low
volatilityValue = stdev(close, volatilityLength) + avg(volatilityRange, volatilityLength) / 2
momentumValue = close - close[momentumLength]
upperLevel = highest(high, breakoutLength) - volatilityValue * 0.5
lowerLevel = lowest(low, breakoutLength) + volatilityValue * 0.5
breakoutUp = close > upperLevel + volatilityValue * volatilityMult * 0.1
breakoutDown = close < lowerLevel - volatilityValue * volatilityMult * 0.1
volAvg = avg(volatilityValue, volatilityLength)
volExpanding = volatilityValue > volatilityValue[1]
volSurge = volatilityValue > 1.5 * volAvg

buyRaw = breakoutUp and momentumValue > 0 and volExpanding
sellRaw = breakoutDown and momentumValue < 0 and volExpanding
buySig = buyRaw and not buyRaw[1]
sellSig = sellRaw and not sellRaw[1]
alertSig = volSurge and not breakoutUp and not breakoutDown
alertEdge = alertSig and not alertSig[1]

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
}
if alertEdge {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Vol Alert", "circle", "#ffcc00")
}
if buySig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}
if sellSig {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "3d")
}

plot(upperLevel, "Upper Level", "#22cc88", 1)
plot(lowerLevel, "Lower Level", "#ff4477", 1)
plot(volatilityValue, "Volatility", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
plot3d(upperLevel, "Upper 3D", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lowerLevel, "Lower 3D", "line3d", "#ff4477", "3d", 1)

lookback = input(80, "Lookback Length", 10, 300, 1)
r236 = input(0.236, "Fib 23.6 Ratio", 0.1, 0.5, 0.001)
r382 = input(0.382, "Fib 38.2 Ratio", 0.1, 0.6, 0.001)
r500 = input(0.5, "Fib 50.0 Ratio", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
r618 = input(0.618, "Fib 61.8 Ratio", 0.1, 0.9, 0.001)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

swingHigh = highest(high, lookback)
swingLow = lowest(low, lookback)
rng = swingHigh - swingLow

lvl236 = swingLow + rng * r236
lvl382 = swingLow + rng * r382
lvl500 = swingLow + rng * r500
lvl618 = swingLow + rng * r618

buySig = crossover(close, lvl618)
sellSig = crossunder(close, lvl382)

var lastBar = 0
var lastPrice = 0.0
var lastIsBuy = false

if buySig {
    lastBar := bar_index
    lastPrice := lvl618
    lastIsBuy := true
}
if sellSig {
    lastBar := bar_index
    lastPrice := lvl382
    lastIsBuy := false
}

if barstate.isconfirmed and buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Reclaim 61.8%", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 3, "3d")
}
if barstate.isconfirmed and sellSig {

    plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Lost 38.2%", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 1, "3d")
}

if barstate.islast and lastBar > 0 {

        text.new(lastBar, lastPrice, "Reclaim 61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "fiboRecent")

    }
}

plot(lvl236, "23.6%", "#00ccff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl382, "38.2%", "#ffcc00", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl500, "50%", "#b48cff", 1, "stepline")
plot(lvl618, "61.8%", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

plot3d(lvl236, "Fib 23.6%", "line3d", "#00ccff", "3d", 0)
plot3d(lvl382, "Fib 38.2%", "line3d", "#ffcc00", "3d", 1)
plot3d(lvl500, "Fib 50%", "line3d", "#b48cff", "3d", 2)
plot3d(lvl618, "Fib 61.8%", "line3d", "#22cc88", "3d", 3)

fastLen = input(10, "Fast Len", 2, 30, 1)
medLen = input(30, "Medium Len", 5, 60, 1)
slowLen = input(60, "Slow Len", 10, 120, 1)
skewLen = input(30, "Skew Len", 5, 100, 1)
compressionThresh = input(0.15, "Compression Thresh", 0.02, 0.5, 0.01)
expansionMult = input(1.25, "Expansion Mult", 1.05, 2.0, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

r = log(close / close[1])
fastVol = stdev(r, fastLen) * sqrt(fastLen)
medVol = stdev(r, medLen) * sqrt(medLen)
slowVol = stdev(r, slowLen) * sqrt(slowLen)

rangeHigh = highest(high, skewLen)
rangeLow = lowest(low, skewLen)
skew = (close - rangeLow) / (rangeHigh - rangeLow + 0.000001) * 2 - 1

spreadFastSlow = fastVol - slowVol
spreadMedSlow = medVol - slowVol

maxFM = max(fastVol, medVol)
maxAll = max(maxFM, slowVol)
minFM = min(fastVol, medVol)
minAll = min(minFM, slowVol)
structureWidth = (maxAll - minAll) / (slowVol + 0.000001)

compression = structureWidth < compressionThresh and fastVol < medVol and medVol <= slowVol
expansion = fastVol > fastVol[1] * expansionMult and fastVol > medVol and compression[1] == true
skewFlipBull = skew[1] < 0 and skew > 0
skewFlipBear = skew[1] > 0 and skew < 0

buySig = expansion == true and skewFlipBull == true
sellSig = expansion == true and skewFlipBear == true

if buySig {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

if sellSig {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, fastVol, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(spreadFastSlow, "Fast-Slow Spread", "#22cc88", 2, "separate")
plot(spreadMedSlow, "Med-Slow Spread", "#ffaa00", 2, "separate")
plot(skew, "Skew", "#4488ff", 1, "separate")
hline(0, "#888888", "separate")

plot3d(fastVol, "Term Structure", "manifold", "#22cc88", "separate", 0)
plot3d(medVol, "Spine", "ribbon", "#ffaa00", "separate", 1)
plot3d(spreadFastSlow, "Impulse", "bars3d", "#4488ff", "separate", 2)

ch1 = input(20, "Ch1", 0, 100, 1)
ch2 = input(40, "Ch2", 0, 100, 1)
ch3 = input(60, "Ch3", 0, 100, 1)
ch4 = input(80, "Ch4", 0, 100, 1)
ch5 = input(100, "Ch5", 0, 100, 1)
maxDbm = input(100, "Max dBm", 10, 200, 1)
thicknessBase = input(1.0, "Thickness Base", 0.5, 5.0, 0.1)
thicknessMax = input(5.0, "Thickness Max", 1.0, 10.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

drift = (close - open) * 2.0 + (close - close[1]) * 1.5 + (bar_index % 10) * 0.2

dch1 = max(0, min(maxDbm, ch1 + drift * 0.5))
dch2 = max(0, min(maxDbm, ch2 + drift * 0.7))
dch3 = max(0, min(maxDbm, ch3 + drift * 1.0))
dch4 = max(0, min(maxDbm, ch4 + drift * 1.2))
dch5 = max(0, min(maxDbm, ch5 + drift * 1.5))

h1 = dch1 / maxDbm * 100
h2 = dch2 / maxDbm * 100
h3 = dch3 / maxDbm * 100
h4 = dch4 / maxDbm * 100
h5 = dch5 / maxDbm * 100

avg = (dch1 + dch2 + dch3 + dch4 + dch5) / 5
avgH = avg / maxDbm * 100

topRaw = max(dch1, max(dch2, max(dch3, max(dch4, dch5))))
topH = topRaw / maxDbm * 100

thickness = thicknessBase + (avg / maxDbm) * (thicknessMax - thicknessBase)

ch5Highest = dch5 >= dch1 and dch5 >= dch2 and dch5 >= dch3 and dch5 >= dch4
ch1Highest = dch1 >= dch2 and dch1 >= dch3 and dch1 >= dch4 and dch1 >= dch5

buyEdge = avg > 70 and avg[1] <= 70
sellEdge = avg < 30 and avg[1] >= 30

buySig = buyEdge and ch5Highest
sellSig = sellEdge and ch1Highest

if buySig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy", "coneup", "#22cc88", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

if sellSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell", "conedown", "#ff4477", 1.0 * markerSize, 0, "separate")
}

plot(h1, "H1", "#ff4477", 1, "separate")
plot(h2, "H2", "#ff9933", 1, "separate")
plot(h3, "H3", "#ffcc33", 1, "separate")
plot(h4, "H4", "#88dd44", 1, "separate")
plot(h5, "H5", "#22cc88", 1, "separate")
plot(avgH, "Avg Height", "#33ccff", 2, "separate")
plot(topH, "Spline Tops 2D", "#ffcc33", thickness, "separate")

plot3d(avgH, "Cell Array Avg", "bars3d", "#22cc88", "separate")
plot3d(topH, "Spline Tops", "ribbon", "#ffcc33", "separate", 1)

windX = input(1.0, "Wind Direction X", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
windY = input(0.0, "Wind Direction Y", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
windZ = input(0.0, "Wind Direction Z", -10.0, 10.0, 0.1)
windSpeedKnots = input(10.0, "Wind Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
minSpeedKnots = input(0.0, "Min Speed Knots", 0.0, 100.0, 0.5)
maxSpeedKnots = input(50.0, "Max Speed Knots", 1.0, 150.0, 0.5)
baseTailLength = input(1.0, "Base Tail Length", 0.2, 5.0, 0.1)
maxStretchFactor = input(3.0, "Max Stretch Factor", 1.0, 6.0, 0.1)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

driftX = (close - open) * 0.02
driftY = (high - low) * 0.01
driftZ = (close - close[1]) * 0.02
speedDrift = (close - open) * 0.05

xEff = windX + driftX
yEff = windY + driftY
zEff = windZ + driftZ
speedEff = windSpeedKnots + speedDrift

vecLen = sqrt(xEff * xEff + yEff * yEff + zEff * zEff)
safeLen = vecLen + 0.000000001
xn = xEff / safeLen
yn = yEff / safeLen
zn = zEff / safeLen

horizLen = sqrt(xEff * xEff + yEff * yEff) + 0.000000001
yawRad = atan2(yEff, xEff)
pitchRad = atan2(zEff, horizLen)
yawDeg = yawRad * 57.29578
pitchDeg = pitchRad * 57.29578
rollDeg = 0.0

spanDen = maxSpeedKnots - minSpeedKnots + 0.000000001
tRaw = (speedEff - minSpeedKnots) / spanDen
tLow = tRaw < 0 ? 0 : tRaw
tNorm = tLow > 1 ? 1 : tLow

tailLen = baseTailLength * (1 + tNorm * (maxStretchFactor - 1))
blueMix = 1 - tNorm

highThresh = 0.8 * maxSpeedKnots
calmThresh = 0.2 * maxSpeedKnots
yawChange = abs(yawDeg - yawDeg[1])
pitchChange = abs(pitchDeg - pitchDeg[1])
shiftState = (yawChange > 30 or pitchChange > 30) and tNorm > 0.5

var calmArmed = 1.0
var shiftPrev = 0.0
calmArmed := calmThresh > 0 ? 1.0 : 1.0
shiftPrev := shiftState[1] ? 1.0 : 0.0

highSig = crossover(speedEff, highThresh)
calmSig = crossunder(speedEff, calmThresh)
shiftEdge = shiftState and not shiftState[1]
shiftSig = shiftEdge and tNorm > 0.5

midMix = tNorm > 0.33 ? 1.0 : 0.0
highMix = tNorm > 0.66 ? 1.0 : 0.0
arrowColor = highMix > 0.5 ? "#ff8800" : midMix > 0.5 ? "#cc8844" : "#3388ff"

arrowSizeRaw = tailLen * markerSize
arrowSizeLow = arrowSizeRaw < 0.2 ? 0.2 : arrowSizeRaw
arrowSize = arrowSizeLow > 3.0 ? 3.0 : arrowSizeLow

arrowState = tNorm > 0.5 and shiftState
arrowSig = arrowState and not arrowState[1]

if highSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "triangleup", "#ff8800")
}
if calmSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "Calm", "triangledown", "#3388ff")
}
if shiftSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800")
}
if arrowSig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Arrow", "diamond", arrowColor)
}
if highSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "HighWind", "coneup", "#ff8800", markerSize, 0, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if calmSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Calm", "conedown", "#3388ff", markerSize, 1, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if shiftSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Shift", "diamond", "#ff8800", markerSize, 2, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}
if arrowSig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "Arrow", "diamond", arrowColor, arrowSize, 3, "separate", pitchDeg, yawDeg, rollDeg)
}

plot(speedEff, "Wind Speed Knots", "#3388ff", 2, "separate")
plot(tailLen, "Tail Length", "#ff8800", 1, "separate")
plot3d(speedEff, "Wind Speed", "ribbon", "#3388ff", "separate")
plot3d(tailLen, "Tail Length", "trail", "#ff8800", "separate", 1)

basePsi = input(100, "Base PSI", 10, 300, 1)
crit = input(150, "Critical Threshold", 50, 300, 1)
spin_factor = input(0.5, "Spin Factor", 0.05, 2.0, 0.05)
max_rings = input(5, "Max Rings", 1, 8, 1)
ring_step = input(1.0, "Ring Expansion Step", 0.1, 5.0, 0.1)
text_off = input(2.0, "Text Height Offset", 0.5, 10.0, 0.5)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

flow_psi = basePsi + (close - open)
spin_speed = flow_psi * spin_factor
over = flow_psi > crit
trig = over and not over[1]
clearTrig = not over and over[1]

var rot = 0.0
var r1 = 0.0
var r2 = 0.0
var r3 = 0.0
var r4 = 0.0
var r5 = 0.0
var lastRing = -100.0

if over {
  rot := rot[1]
} else {
  rot := rot[1] + spin_speed
}

if over {
  r1 := r1[1] + ring_step * 1.0
  r2 := r2[1] + ring_step * 2.0
  r3 := r3[1] + ring_step * 3.0
  r4 := r4[1] + ring_step * 4.0
  r5 := r5[1] + ring_step * 5.0
} else {
  r1 := 0.0
  r2 := 0.0
  r3 := 0.0
  r4 := 0.0
  r5 := 0.0
}

ringCount = max_rings
ringAvg = (r1 + r2 + r3 + r4 + r5) / 5.0
discVal = rot + flow_psi * 0.1 + close * 0.01
shockVal = ringAvg + flow_psi * 0.05 + close * 0.01
lockState = over
ringSize1 = 0.5 + r1 * 0.08
ringSize2 = 0.5 + r3 * 0.05
ringSize3 = 0.5 + r5 * 0.03
spinRy = rot
labelPrice = flow_psi + text_off + (high - low) * 0.2

if trig {
  plotshape(bar_index, low, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangleup", "#ff4477")
}

if clearTrig {
  plotshape(bar_index, high, "Release", "triangledown", "#22cc88")
}

if trig {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flow_psi, "Lock", "torus", "#22aaff", markerSize, 0, "separate", 0, spinRy, 0)
}

if over and bar_index - lastRing >= 3 {
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flow_psi, "Ring1", "torus", "#ff4477", ringSize1, 1, "separate", 0, spinRy, 0)
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flow_psi, "Ring2", "torus", "#ff8844", ringSize2, 2, "separate", 0, spinRy, 0)
  plotshape_3d(bar_index, flow_psi, "Ring3", "torus", "#ffcc44", ringSize3, 3, "separate", 0, spinRy, 0)
  lastRing := bar_index
}

if trig {
  label3d(bar_index, labelPrice, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", markerSize, 4, "separate")
}

plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(discVal, "Disc Spin", "#44ddff", 1, "separate")
hline(crit, "#ff4477", "separate")
plot3d(discVal, "Valve Disc", "torus", "#22aaff", "separate")
plot3d(shockVal, "Shockwaves", "vortex", "#ff4477", "separate", 1)
